The normalized product converges, giving a rigorously controlled depth asymptotic. Every quantified statement is proved analytically.

value.rationale: This gives the exact intrinsic two-character Gram conditioning invariant and every minimizing arithmetic gap for all finite, uniformly weighted, three-consecutive-digit Cantor measures in every integer base b≥4. It reveals a sharp base-divisibility transition between exact orthogonality and superexponentially small but nonzero best correlation, with an explicit depth constant. This specific quantitative invariant is not supplied by qualitative spectral existence classification and is useful for finite near-Hadamard Fourier sampling of Cantor cylinders.
